notes: Page is the AAF-McQuay group page (AAF, McQuay, Remington and others); only style 1 is shipped here, transcribed from this page. Style 1 year/week positions are counted on the normalized (spaces stripped) serial: AUBU080500386 gives year 08 and week 05. Styles 2 and 3 held: their year/month codes are single characters decoded only via the page chart images (AAF_McQuay-Style-2.png, AAF_McQuay-Style-3.png), with no text table on the page; style 2's two printed forms also disagree in length (55A1234501 in the list vs 55A123501 in the detail). No sister reuse claimed.

styles.era: AUBU-style serials, 4 letters followed by 9 digits
styles.notes: Page states year is 5th and 6th characters combined and week is 7th and 8th characters combined, counted on the normalized serial.
